completion.source: Insider Gaming's 100% completion task list, as reported by GTA VI Vice City Hub. Where a task's target differs from a trophy's own PSN counter, the trophy counter is the one that matters for the trophy — the 100% list is the game's own checklist, and this guide notes the two places they disagree (meditation spots: 15 here, 18 on the trophy; see the trophy's own guide).

saveStrategy: GTA VI has no mission replay and no New Game Plus. The game gives you 15 manual save slots: keep one at the start of every chapter, one before the final mission, and one before each stranger strand and each one-off challenge. Cheats switch trophies off for that session, and saving too — so play the whole run clean. If a trophy can be missed, this guide says so on the trophy itself and on the Missables page.

stages.note: Chapters 1–4 and the finale. Twelve trophies: six chapter and finale milestones and six named missions. Do the Chapter 1 meditation for Positive Mental Attitude before Chapter 1 ends — it is the only confirmed missable in the game. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter.
stages.title: Play the story

stages.note: Eight stranger strands across Leonida, including the five named finals (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone). Start each strand as soon as it appears and finish it before moving far past its chapter — no public source confirms the strands reopen, and there is no mission replay.
stages.title: Strangers and side missions

stages.note: The repeatable core: shooting range golds, races, drone races, fishing, arcade, bowling, pool, mini golf, stunts, challenges, meditation, hunting and the odd one-offs. Nothing here is missable except the two flagged risks (Cal's fishing challenge and the VCIA departure) — do those the first time they appear.
stages.title: Activities and skills

stages.note: Heists, vaults, shops, armored trucks, gang operations, laundering, spending and properties — plus the collectibles: card sets, WAiNK spots, vehicles and garage deeds. All repeatable in free roam. Work the money trophies together: vaults and trucks feed Marked Bills, which feed the $250,000 laundering total.
stages.title: Crime, money and collections

stages.note: Finish the 35-task completion list below. Its targets run higher than the matching trophies (300 stunts against 250, 70 challenges against 50, 15 card sets against 3, all 8 vaults against 5), so the cleanup keeps going after those trophies pop. A Long Road pops at 100%, and the Platinum pops with it.
